top_issues.issue: Dialog geometry is not shared: close buttons and title insets vary per dialog, and the shortcuts close button is badly misplaced
top_issues.evidence: shortcuts: dialog x 166-1114, title ink starts x 190 (24 px inset) but close X ink at x 1005-1014 (~100 px from the right edge). Title insets: status 21 px, settings 22 px, consent 23 px, shortcuts 24 px
top_issues.fix: One dialog frame widget: 24 px padding on all sides, title 20 pt semibold baseline at 24+20 px, close button 28x28 hit area anchored 16 px from top-right edge for every dialog

top_issues.issue: Scrolled content is sliced under the header: half avatars, cut card borders and a faded text line remain visible
top_issues.evidence: chats y 44-60 faded text #b1b1b2 on #ffffff = 2.14:1 (dark #606064 on #17181b = 2.84:1); channel-narrow top card border and avatar cut at y 52; composer-images avatar half hidden at y 45-60
top_issues.fix: Clip the scroll area at the header's bottom border and use a 12 px fade from the page background to transparent, or snap the initial scroll so the first visible item starts whole; never show a partially faded text line

top_issues.issue: Calendar detail pane is sparse and off-grid: no attendees/location, header misaligned, unlabeled line in the label/value card
top_issues.evidence: Header title starts x 462 while chats/channel headers start x 394-436; card has 3 label/value rows then a free 'Join on your computer...' line; ~60% of the 916 px pane empty
top_issues.fix: Align the header to the pane's 32 px content inset; add Attendees (avatars + count) and Location rows; move the join line under the Join button as 12 pt helper text; give the title 18 pt semibold

top_issues.issue: Control heights are inconsistent; inputs and adjacent buttons do not line up
top_issues.evidence: calls: link input y 125-152 (28 px) next to Join button y 125-156 (32 px). Filter field 28 px, new-chat search 32 px, composer 44 px, setup fields 28 px
top_issues.fix: Two control heights only: 32 px (dialogs, forms, inline buttons) and 28 px (dense sidebars). Put input and its button on one 32 px row with shared vertical centre

top_issues.issue: Running-text leading differs card to card
top_issues.evidence: Line pitch: signin-finishing 17 px (lines at y 369, 386), signin 20 px, signin-device-code 23 px (y 368, 391); signin-finishing title 15 pt vs 18 pt elsewhere
top_issues.fix: Use one body style for card copy: 14 pt / 20 px leading; card titles 18 pt semibold with 8 px gap to body, including the spinner title on signin-finishing

top_issues.issue: At 760 px the sidebar keeps its width and the content truncates heavily
top_issues.evidence: Sidebar spans x 64-296 (232 px); names truncate to 'Grace Hop...', 'Katherine Jo...', 'Dorothy Vaug...'; calls rows keep two 32 px icon buttons visible
top_issues.fix: Below 900 px: shrink list to 248 px and hide the timestamp column into the second line, or collapse the list to avatars only (64 px); in calls show call buttons only on hover/selection

top_issues.issue: Orange accent is overloaded: own author name, mentions, unread times, unread dots, selection bars, focus rings, primary buttons and DEMO all use #a9530f / #e88c3e; calendar adds a competing blue
top_issues.evidence: own name 'Alex Rivera' #a9530f in both the author slot and the @mention; mention row tint #fdf1e5; calendar dots blue while selection is orange
top_issues.fix: Keep orange for actions/selection/unread; render own author name in the primary text colour (#1b1c1f / #e9e9ec) and mentions as an orange pill (bg #fdf1e5, text #8f440a, 4 px radius); use orange or category colours for calendar dots

top_issues.issue: Message-row hover state is almost invisible
top_issues.fix: Hover fill light #f0f0f2 (1.13) plus show timestamp/toolbar, or dark #212227; keep the selected chat row at #e4e4e8 / #34353c

top_issues.issue: Thread cards have staggered right edges and the hover toolbar straddles the card border
top_issues.evidence: card right border at x 1251 (top), 1253 (hovered), 1255 (bottom); toolbar y 263-300 overlaps card top border at y 262
top_issues.fix: Give all cards the same width from one column measure; place the toolbar 8 px inside the card's top-right padding

top_issues.issue: Shortcut list has inconsistent notation and section spacing
top_issues.evidence: 'Shift Enter' vs 'Ctrl+K'; keycaps containing prose ('@ in the composer', 'in an empty composer'); 'APP' header follows 'Next account' with ~12 px gap vs 24 px before NAVIGATION content
top_issues.fix: Write 'Shift+Enter'; keep keycaps to keys and move context into the description column; 24 px above each section header

top_issues.issue: Setup page shows a near-full-height scrollbar and mismatched field fonts/copy
top_issues.evidence: scrollbar thumb x 1272-1279 spans y 0-790 (#727376 light, #96979a dark); placeholder in monospace, tenant value in Inter; helper references 'the one shown' GUID that is not shown
top_issues.fix: Reduce top logo margin 40 px so the page fits 800 px; use Inter for the placeholder or show a sample GUID in mono ('00000000-0000-...'); 18 px between field groups

top_issues.issue: Hover tooltip overflows the card, overlaps the divider and is larger than its trigger
top_issues.evidence: tooltip x 607-1117 extends 242 px past the card edge at 875; text 14 pt vs 13 pt button; 7 px horizontal padding
top_issues.fix: Tooltips 12 pt, max width 280 px, 8x6 px padding, placed below the trigger and kept inside the window with 8 px margin

top_issues.issue: Image preview wastes space and thumbnails crop badly
top_issues.evidence: preview canvas x 176-1104, y 119-752 holds a 917x67 image strip; thumbnails cover-crop 3072x256 into 144x96 fragments
top_issues.fix: Size the preview to the image (fit, max 90% window) with a dark canvas; thumbnails use contain on a neutral #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 tile so whole images show; add Copy/Save buttons in the header

top_issues.issue: Failed-send state is inconsistent between list and thread
top_issues.evidence: list row shows 'Not sent' (#b42525 on #e4e4e8 = 5.12) but preview text still 'Amazing. I'll write...'; failed tint starts 2 px below the link underline at y 603
top_issues.fix: Preview the failed draft text ('You: Here are the throttling numbers.'); add 8 px top margin before the failed message tint

top_issues.issue: Call bar wraps into three rows at 380 px and leaves big empty bands above the chat
top_issues.evidence: call bar y 0-110 at 380 px wide; empty band y 170-280 before 'Yesterday'
top_issues.fix: At <480 px use icon-only buttons (32 px) with tooltips on one row; anchor history to the bottom so no empty band shows

top_issues.issue: Light-mode accent text passes AA with almost no headroom
top_issues.evidence: DEMO #a9530f on rail #ececee = 4.53:1; unread time #a9530f on #f6f6f7 = 4.95:1; mention name on #fdf1e5 = 4.81:1
top_issues.fix: Darken text-use accent to #9a4a0c (about 5.9:1 on #ffffff, 5.2 on #ececee) while keeping #a9530f for fills

top_issues.issue: Account menu mixes status states and actions with equal styling and is crowded
top_issues.evidence: 'Reset status' and 'Set a status message' share the 13 pt row style of the six presence states; menu bottom 12 px above window edge
top_issues.fix: Divider after 'Appear offline', show current status message as a row with edit icon, render actions with leading 16 px icons in secondary colour; keep 16 px window margin
